tools.name: whats_in_season
tools.description: This week's seasonal selection on Mixly: the fresh ingredients in season this month (northern hemisphere) and a varied set of recipes that use what is in season. The selection changes every Monday. Use it for questions like what to cook this week or what is in season now.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_recipe" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Get one Mixly recipe in full: description, total and active time, servings, ingredients, numbered steps with Thermomix settings (time, temperature, speed, rever…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
